messages:
Anya: Quick async check — Q2 milestone cascade update. TL;DR: infra routing shipped, embeddings overdue, gpt-lite rollout slipped. Please reply with: shipped/slipped + owner + blocker + next step.

Mike: infra routing (ENG-Runtime) — shipped yesterday. owner: Mike. No blocker. next: roll to prod region eu-west on Mon. :tada:

Sara: great, can we get perf numbers + a short note for release notes? @Mike

Mike: will post perf summary in the docs later today: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra-routing/q2

Priya: embeddings pipeline — slipped. owner: Priya. Reason: dataset tagging lag (third-party vendor throughput). ETA: +2 weeks. Blocker: annotation vendor capacity. Next: vendor call Fri & implement fallback heuristic if not resolved.

Leo: gpt-lite rollout — partially slipped. canary tests show elevated memory usage. owner: Leo. Blocker: quantization hotpath in runtime kernels. Next: debug with eng-runtime + kernel team, then rerun canary. Can someone from runtime pair tomorrow morning?

Anya: volunteers? @Mike @Priya

Mike: I can pair tomorrow morning. will need kernel logs; quick cmd to grab them: `kubectl logs -l app=gpt-lite-canary -n integration --tail=500`

Priya: I can join after the vendor call (~11:30am PT).

Leo: thanks — attaching current canary logs in ~30m to the PR.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2024-06-15T09:12:33Z started for gpt-lite-canary (rev: 2f9a) — status: in_progress

Anya: Product question — any API contract changes that would require migration notes?

Mike: No API contract changes. Only runtime flags and a config toggle. I'll add a one-line note to the release PR and mention fallback toggle.

Sara: OK. For OKR scoring: infra routing shipped -> counts toward "Reduce routing latency" KR. embeddings slip -> mark partial progress. gpt-lite -> pending until we clear canary. I'll assemble scoreboard by EOD and post to the OKR doc.

Leo: fyi I flagged an autoscale tweak to prevent mem spikes, PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/824

Priya: vendor fallback patch is ready locally. I'll open the PR after the call: `git checkout -b vendor-fallback && git push origin vendor-fallback`

Anya: Next-steps summary (I'll post to the OKR doc):
- infra routing: shipped -> Mike to roll to prod EU on Mon
- embeddings: slipped -> Priya vendor call Fri; fallback plan if unresolved; ETA +2w
- gpt-lite: canary issues -> Mike+Leo debug tomorrow, add kernel logs to PR
- action: Sara will update OKR scoreboard EOD
Thanks all :thumbsup:

Mike: noted. I'll update prod runbook and ping infra for capacity.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2024-06-15T09:24:10Z completed for infra-routing (rev: a1b2) — status: success
